gaps.explanation: Statement p5 prints one row 'Transfers from (to) other funds': General Fund 150,000, Street Fund 6,806, Debt Service Fund (7,543), Total Governmental Funds 149,263 (net; JSON transfers_in 149,263 = the Total = the transfers from the utilities, p7 Total (149,263)). Detail records the transfers gross: General Fund department General 154,100 (p14) + Street Fund 6,806 (p11) = 160,906 in; Community Center (4,100) (p15) + Debt Service Fund (7,543) (p12) = 11,643 out. 160,906 - 11,643 = 149,263 = statement; the gap 11,643 is the gross outflows the Total column nets. No fix.

No business-type line is in detail. Proprietary funds statement p7 prints Sewer Fund / Water Fund / Landfill Fund columns.
